_howto: curl the file, then extract ONE section with python json. Never print the whole file. Update it at the end of every scan and redeploy alongside index.html.

watermark.note: Backend has no since filter yet. Pull full JSON to a FILE with curl -o, diff in python against rowCounts, print only the delta. Never cat the raw response.

deploy.doNotTrust: raw.githubusercontent lags several minutes behind. Never verify with it.
deploy.commitRule: Commit summary MUST be under 50 characters. Over 50 GitHub inserts a ProTip line that shifts the Commit button ~22px and the click misses.
deploy.pagesNote: Rebuild is normally under 2 min. If stalled past 10, check /deployments/github-pages for a failed build and push a fresh commit to clear it.

traps: api.github.com repo endpoints are BLOCKED from the cloud sandbox. The stored token is ALIVE (200 on /user) - the old note saying it is dead with 401 is WRONG. The 403 is the sandbox, not the token.
Apps Script endpoint returns 302. POST, then GET the redirect_url manually. curl -L turns it into a 405.
The Apps Script IDE ignores programmatic Monaco edits. setValue and executeEdits both apply visually but Save writes the old content. Only real keyboard or clipboard input registers.
GitHub commit summary over 50 chars shifts the Commit button. Keep it short.
